Name: Darker Vanilla Crops
Author: deleted116366473
Description:
This mod changes the whole of TileSheets/crops to make all vanilla crops in there look darker.

For this purpose I created 5 different shades to choose from.

To choose a shade easily, please use the mod "Generic Mod Config Menu".

If you don't want to use that mod, start your game and exit it again, this will spawn a config.json inside the mod folder for "Darker Vanilla Crops".

Inside Generic Mod Config Menu or the config.json you can choose a number between 1 and 5, the bigger the number gets the darker the crops will become.

The default number is 2.



This is the first mod I've ever made, if you want to make your forage look darker too, please visit my other mod "Darker Vanilla Forage".

Manifest.Name: Darker Vanilla Crops
Manifest.Description: Makes vanilla crops a bit darker to fit in with darker recolor mods.
